entities.name: PMID:27502058
observations: Grover et al. studied 327 adults; 37 anthracycline-treated survivors imaged about 2.8 years after chemotherapy had age-adjusted native T1 of 1040±7 ms versus 965±3 ms in 236 cancer-free comparators (P<0.0001).

T1 remained elevated after adjustment for demographics, myocardial-fibrosis risk factors, and LVEF or myocardial mass index (P<0.0001); authors reported independence from cardiovascular comorbidities.

entities.name: Anthracycline survivor T1 elevation
observations: In adult cancer survivors, native myocardial T1 was elevated about 2.8 years after anthracycline therapy versus cancer-free comparators and remained significant after multivariable adjustment including cardiovascular risk factors.
